sourceScope: #123 describes maintaining familiar kettlebell/club/mace work while shifting toward conventional lifting. It does not prescribe get-up review frequency or a universal maintenance dose. #85/#548 support interlocking programs and keeping fundamentals. The distinction between review eligibility and dedicated scheduling urgency is a Strength Lab adaptation, using the existing configured return window rather than inventing a Wildman numerical interval.
behavior: A canonical, fully delivered earned-maintenance receipt at the current method, track and load can defer a dedicated full-review workout when a developing program has capacity and the existing next-visit return-window check is not due.
Full endpoint work remains required for load review; no lighter prescription, earned progress or automatic load increase is introduced.
Full reviews that fit alongside existing work retain their original priority. If no developing lane has capacity, maintenance-only behavior is unchanged.

Failed, incomplete, held, recovery, reentry, alternate-volume and unverified legacy evidence cannot grant this deferral. Existing core reservations, prerequisites, equipment and time ceilings remain in force.
The overdue check overrides the deferral. Forecasts, imports, history edits and undo use actual receipts; V33 data and settings are unchanged.

results.ordinaryGeneratedTrajectories: All six before/after comparisons retain identical counts, qualification dates, progress and next-curriculum output: 120 actual workouts each at 30/45/60 minutes, plus 286 each with two-year constraints. This fix targets dedicated displacement; it does not claim broad reentry improvement.

historyLookup.limit: Synthetic local lookup timing, not a real-device latency guarantee

results.dedicatedLongTermScope: 120 scheduled opportunities / 119 actual workouts at three days per week. At 30 minutes: row qualification June 26 to June 19; squat/lunge July 17 to July 13; two-hand hip drop August 12 to August 7; bear squat August 26 to August 14; single-hand hip drop August 31 to August 26. Total earned returns remain 14 and developing returns zero. One later earned row return replaces a return elsewhere; get-up return count remains three. 45/60-minute histories are unchanged. These are synthetic outcomes, not physical guarantees.
results.reproduceDedicated: node scripts/compare-maintenance.cjs /tmp/prior-engine.js (export baseCommit engine.js with git show first)

limitations: All ten Wildman gate areas remain unresolved.
This explicitly selected actual history models an experienced get-up trainee adopting a broader curriculum; it is not claimed to have been produced by the automatic coordinator.
Large cores, low attendance and broader curriculum admission still limit developing opportunities. No universal movement minimum frequency has been established.
A broader prototype that also delayed full-review additions changed ordinary return outcomes unfavorably and was discarded. Existing additions and maintenance-only cadence are retained.
Browser mobile emulation is not physical Android or technique acceptance.

verification.scope: Complete local regression, with final expanded maintenance test rerun; exact-head remote checks and live DEV acceptance follow push.
